SEEING Kumbhakarna fall under the blows of the cxcccdingly

" 0 King, the rival of Kala is dead ! Having overthrown

Streaming with blood, his nose and ears 
severed, his head obstructing Lanka's gateway, he who resembled 
a mountain, Kumbhakarna, thy brother, srruck down by

Hearing this report of the mighty Kumbhakarna's death on

Learning that their paternal uncle had been slain, Dcvantaka,

and Mahodara and Mahaparshwa, on hearing that their brother

Thereafter, regaining his senses with cxrremc difficulty, that

" 0 Hero, 0 Humbler of the pride of thy foes, 0 Mighty 
Kumbhakarna, urged on by destiny, thou hast left me for the

Seeing thee succumb in combat, the Hosts of the Gods, standing

Kumbhakarna, now that thou art dead, how shall I vanquish

Such were the many burning lamentations to which the 
Ten-necked Ravana gave voice in the anguish of his soul on 
account of Kumbhaltarna, his younger brother, the enemy of 
Indra, and, knowing him to have perished in combat, he swooned

brief.summary_1line: After Kumbhakarna is slain by Rama, messengers inform Ravana, who collapses in grief and laments the loss of his brother and his own doomed choices.

image_candidates.scene_text: The gigantic mutilated body of Kumbhakarna lies like a fallen mountain, half submerged in the ocean with his severed head blocking the gate of Lanka.
Ravana collapses unconscious on the palace floor as demon messengers report the death of his colossal brother.
Ravana, the ten-headed king, laments in anguish in his court while grieving demon princes and ministers stand around him.
